the reactivity of heterocyclic compounds depends on the nature of the heteroatom and its location in the heterocyclic ring.

heterocycles are characterized by a significant degree of conjugation of the π-electron system with the σ-electron system, which is manifested in a significant contribution of the σ-orbitals of the atoms of the heteroaromatic ring to the molecular orbitals of the π-system.

the electronic structure of heterocyclic compounds, in particular, the distribution of electron density over the π-system and the nature of its delocalization, is determined by the type of heteroatoms in the cycle and their number, as well as by the position of the heteroatoms in it.
